english.title: Produce / supply tobacco product containing vitamins / additives / stimulant prohibited under reg 16
english.standardoffencewording:

(C)_[produced and supplied]_

(D)_[vitamins or other additives that created the impression that the product had a health benefit or presented reduced health risks]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 16(1), 48(a)(ii) and 51 of the Tobacco and Related Products Regulations 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
produced / supplied
tobacco product which contained
vitamins / additives creating impression of a health benefit / reduced health risk OR
additive / stimulant compounds associated with energy / vitality OR
additives which had colouring effects on emissions OR
additives that facilitated inhalation / nicotine uptake

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In any proceedings for an offence under these Regulations brought against a person who supplies any tobacco product or related product in breach of these Regulations, it is a defence that the supplier exercised all due diligence to avoid committing the offence.
(ii) This offence does not apply to the supply of a tobacco product where -
(a) the product was produced before 20th May 2016, or released for free circulation within the European Union before that date;
(b) the supply took place before 20th May 2017; and (c) the product complied with the Tobacco Products (Manufacture, Presentation and Sale) (Safety) Regulations 2002 at the time of supply.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None
